name: 73-tests-not-proof
body:
[73-tests-not-proof] Observable behavior verifies

Desired behavior
Result confirmed by real scenario + related logs after the last material edit.

Executable contract
1. Checkable property + discriminating scenario derived from requirements, independent of ready code/test/explanation. Minimal sufficient observation chosen.
2. Real scenario run in the installed state; result + relevant logs inspected. test/build/typecheck/lint confirms only what it directly measures. Real mechanism inside a test useful when deciding conditions + result are visible.
3. UI after the last significant edit → real render obtained + inspected; measurements, readable screenshots, interaction = different properties. Text → content, meaning, completeness, fitness checked directly.
4. Prediction + substantial wrong alternatives compared. One failure never masks independent properties. Reproduced violation fixed, affected check repeated.
5. Conditions, observations, unverified parts recorded; check expansion stops when material uncertainty + mandatory gates are closed.

Tools and skills
bash/native runtime for actual execution; UI: available web-inspector/browser/desktop + matching skill. Screenshot always inspected; get_console_logs + relevant network details per scenario. Unavailable logs/environment = stated limitation.

Links: 70-reasoning-poison, 75-evidence-or-blocker, 77-layout-model-and-verification, 80-independent-review.

Anti-patterns
Green suite/verdict as proof of the whole product; unviewed screenshot; checks instead of implementation; criterion changed to pass; one example as whole coverage.
